speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me when these symptoms of gait and limb ataxia first began, and have you noticed any progression over time?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see you mentioned the ataxia is more pronounced on the right side; have you experienced any recent headaches, double vision, or difficulty swallowing? Please also describe your past medical history, specifically any history of cancer or autoimmune conditions.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and recent treatment with natalizumab, I am concerned about the risk of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI_with_contrast
